newsitem.title: INDIA: Malaysia's Mahathir arrives in India.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Mahathir arrives in India.

text.p: Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad arrived in the Indian capital New Delhi on Thursday at the start of a three-day visit, the Press Trust of India (PTI) reported.

Mahathir, who is accompanied by three cabinet ministers, will meet Indian President Shankar Dayal Sharma, Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda and Foreign Minister I.K. Gujral, foreign ministry officials said.
He is also scheduled to receive the Jawaharlal Nehru Award for international understanding on Friday, PTI said.
The award is named after India's first prime minister.
Mahathir will meet with Indian businessmen, and deliver a lecture on India's relationship with the ASEAN trade bloc.
The Association of South East Asian Nations (ASEAN) groups Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.
